description: Publish a community favor only with explicit publication authorization; this mutates public data despite using GET and requiring no API key. Just provide the entity slug and direction. This tool calls the community favor URL (GET request). Favors carry 0.1x weight (vs 1.0x for expert reviews). Never fetch a favor URL as a read-only check or automatic link preview. Reviews are separate optional public writes and require actual evaluation and publication authorization.
name: nanmesh.trust.favor
title: Favor or Oppose — Instant Community Signal
